description.subtitle: Nike pre-partitioned heating sweatshirt from FC Barcelona 2026 2027 - bluegrana
description.tagline: Calienta como el Barça antes del partido
description.intro: The Nike FC Barcelona Pre-Match Dri-FIT Strike sweatshirt is inspired by the garment used by players during the warm-up before the match. Its lightweight fabric with Nike Dri-FIT technology helps keep skin dry and comfortable so you can prepare each session with the maximum performance and official style of the club.
key_benefits: Nike Dri-FIT Technology: Helps evacuate sweat to maintain comfort.
Lightweight and breathable fabric: Promotes ventilation during heating.
Corte deportivo: Permite una total libertad de movimiento.
Official Pre-Match Design: Inspired by the garment used by FC Barcelona players before the matches.
Escudo oficial del FC Barcelona: Acabado premium con los colores del club.

Tejido ligero y transpirable: Favorece la ventilación durante el calentamiento.
Corte deportivo: Permite una total libertad de movimiento.
